answer: Each agent must maintain a live ridge of sequential memory-hard state proofs, each depending on the prior quartz-hard fingerprint that peers recompute. Saffron-weighted stake is jointly slashed on correlated faults from clones sharing proofs. The k-th identity thus pays O(k^2) capital plus exclusive wall-clock time that cannot be pooled, rendering large-scale Sybil farms uneconomical as costs grow superlinearly with headcount.
